newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Banque Indosuez to close Bahrain treasury.
newsitem.headline: Banque Indosuez to close Bahrain treasury.

text.p: Banque Indosuez, an offshore bank, will close its treasury department in Bahrain by the end of 1996, a bank official said on Sunday.
The official said "yes" when asked if the bank will close its treasury department in Bahrain, the Gulf's main financial and banking centre. He declined to elaborate.
The Bahrain Monetary Agency, the country's central bank, said in its 1995 annual report that there were 47 offshore banking units (OBUs) operating in Bahrain.
OBU's assets dropped to $61.50 billion in the first half of 1996 from $67.98 billion in the same period of the previous year.
Swiss Bank Corporation plans to close its offshore banking unit in Bahrain at the end of this year, banking sources said last month.
